questions.q: Which actress played Natasha Romanoff in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.why: Scarlett Johansson first played the character in Iron Man 2 (2010) and led Black Widow (2021).

questions.q: In the comics, Natasha was trained in which Soviet facility?
questions.why: The Red Room is the Soviet program that biotechnologically augmented her and trained her as a spy.

questions.q: In her 1964 debut, Black Widow was a Soviet spy who targeted which billionaire?
questions.why: Natasha first appeared as a seductress spy menacing Tony Stark in Tales of Suspense.

questions.q: In which comic did Black Widow debut in April 1964?
questions.why: Her debut came in Tales of Suspense #52, cover-dated April 1964.

questions.q: She switched sides in the Avengers comics in 1966, driven by her love for whom?
questions.why: Her love for Hawkeye pushed her to defect and later join the Avengers.

questions.q: Which artist designed her black costume with long red hair, introduced in Amazing Spider-Man #86 (1970)?
questions.why: John Romita Sr. gave her the black catsuit and long red hair look in Amazing Spider-Man #86.

questions.q: Which Captain America sidekick, as the Winter Soldier, instructed Natasha in the Soviet program and became her lover?
questions.why: Bucky Barnes, as the Winter Soldier, was one of her instructors and they were romantically involved.

questions.q: She joined the cast of a Marvel title with issue #81 (1971) and became its hero's romantic partner. Whose title?
questions.why: She joined Daredevil #81 in 1971 and became closely tied to Matt Murdock through the 1970s.

questions.q: Which Russian operative took the Black Widow name in Inhumans #5 (1999)?
questions.why: Yelena Belova claimed the Black Widow name in 1999, and the two Widows later clashed.

questions.q: Which film first featured Natasha Romanoff in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.why: She debuted as the character in Iron Man 2 (2010), before the Avengers films.
